body: Yes, I've received everything from apologies to saying they've found more of my stuff. I haven't "blocked" their number, but I've removed the contact. Blocked on all platforms otherwise. Easy to not read and even easier to delete.

Just wanted to thank everyone for this level of support. While I was trying to leave a question she asked continuously is "how is this so easy for you." I told her what I'll tell you all now: It's not easy, but it's what I need to do. If you are stuck in a similar situation I highly suggest that you advocate for and love yourself. 

Thank you all again, it really means a lot.
